entities.summary: The Art Museum of Prykarpattia, originally the Ivano-Frankivsk Regional Art Museum is a regional art museum located at 8 Maidan Andrey Sheptytskyi, Ivano-Frankivsk, Ukraine, in the former Church of Virgin Mary. It has one of the best collections of local religious art, and specializes in displaying works by local artists.
